Download Nomi

Local-first, with no cloud account required

Chats, memories and the knowledge base stay on your computer by default. Nomi operates no cloud account service — you choose which models to connect.

No cloud account

No sign-up required; session history and preferences stay in local storage.

OS Keychain encryption

API keys are stored in the OS keychain with automatic outbound masking.

Default sandbox isolation

macOS system sandbox blocks SSH/Git credential reads outside project folders.

Local-first by default

Conversations, long-term memories and knowledge-base indexes are stored locally on your machine rather than uploaded to Nomi servers (the project runs no cloud account backend).

Controls in your hands

  • One-click export: export all local data and conversation history.
  • Editable memory: view, edit, delete or export your profile and memories any time.
  • Local-only file access: restrict file and knowledge reading exclusively to local models.
  • Encrypted keys: provider API keys live in the OS keychain and render masked in UI.
  • Confirmation gates: sensitive MCP tools, writes and high-risk commands prompt first; deletions use trash.

What happens with cloud models

When you choose to connect cloud providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic, or use an official CLI login, requests go directly to that provider under their privacy policy. Outbound masking strips API key patterns before sending. Use local models to keep everything offline.

Optional features stay off

Optional capabilities such as the desktop character, proactive chat and clipboard history are off by default and can be toggled any time.

Learn more

Read the full security boundaries and storage layout in Privacy & Security docs, and brand commitments in BRAND.md。
